title: Specht ideals for the imprimitive complex reflection group $G(r,1,n)$: geometric orbit types and a dominance theorem
summary: Moustrou, Riener, and Verdure related the dominance order on partitions to Specht ideal and variety inclusion for $S_n$; we previously extended this to direct products of symmetric groups. Here we take a first step toward the imprimitive complex reflection group $G(r,1,n)=(\mathbb{Z}/r\mathbb{Z})\wr S_n$. The correct geometric invariant of a point $x\in K^n$ is a pair $(μ,z)$: a classical partition $μ$ on the $r$-th powers of the nonzero coordinates, together with the number $z$ of zero coordinates.
